messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: High error rate and queue growth on Dedicated Pool 'eu-west-1-dedicated-3' detected. Autoscaler failing to add burst GPUs. Paging eng-oncall. Incident doc: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-20260301
Mia Rao: i'm on it. seeing a bunch of 503s from serving runtime and pod CPU at 98%. autoscaler logs show repeated scaleup attempts that time out.
Carlos Nguyen: looks like the scale API to the cloud failed with 504s from provider. kube events show 'insufficient capacity' for the requested instance type.
Priya Shah: traffic spike from a customer onboarding job + ramping concurrent inference. Could be combo of big batch jobs + cold kv caches. Need quick mitigation to protect SLA.
Jen Ortiz: support: we have three customers reporting elevated latency on embeddings endpoints. I flagged the enterprise accounts on the incident page.
Mia Rao: short-term plan: 1) enable burst capacity toggle for eu-west-1-dedicated-3 (adds smaller instance types) 2) throttle large batch requests via quota change for new tenants 3) disable non-critical background prefetching to free up slots. I'll execute 1 and 2 now.
Carlos Nguyen: i'm preparing the burst toggle command. ops role required. command: ```rb-control pool set-burst --pool eu-west-1-dedicated-3 --enable --instance-types g5-small,g5-medium```
Priya Shah: recommend also lowering max_batch_size in runtime config to reduce per-request compute for the next 10m: ```kubectl patch config map/runtime-config -n inference --type=json -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/max_batch_size","value":"64"}]'```
Mia Rao: executing burst toggle (ops role), running now.
ops-bot: runbook-check: confirmed runbook INC-DEDICATED-SURGE applicable. Notifying capacity team.
ops-bot: executed: rb-control pool set-burst --pool eu-west-1-dedicated-3 --enable --instance-types g5-small,g5-medium (request id rb-44729)
Carlos Nguyen: provider accepted request but some instances are delayed. provisioning at 45% progress. we should still apply traffic shaping.
Mia Rao: applying temporary quota change for new tenants: ```rb-admin quotas update --scope new_tenants --token T123 --qps 5```
Jen Ortiz: i've messaged the affected customers that we're throttling new onboarding traffic and working on capacity. keeping nice tone.
Priya Shah: rolling out max_batch_size change now. will monitor latency tail.
Mia Rao: also disabling prefetch in runtime: ```rb-admin config set --name prefetch_enabled --value false --env eu-west-1``` toggled.
Carlos Nguyen: quick health check: 5xx errors falling from 18% -> 6% in last 2 minutes. CPU pressure also easing to ~70%.
Priya Shah: KV cache warmup looks slower because of disabled prefetch; expected. we'll re-enable after surge.
incident-bot: UPDATE: incident severity set to P2. Document updated: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-20260301#timeline
Mia Rao: next step, if instances finish provisioning we'll scale nodepool to desired count; otherwise keep burst enabled and keep quotas in place for 30m. Any objections?
Carlos Nguyen: no objections. I'll watch provider API and try alternate instance types if capacity stalls. prepping fallback: ```rb-control pool set-burst --pool eu-west-1-dedicated-3 --instance-types a1-small,a1-medium```
Jen Ortiz: support: customers ok with this approach. asked for ETA; told them 20-30m.
Priya Shah: adding automated rollback: if 5xx > 10% for 10m, we'll revert the quota change to avoid breaking higher-priority tenants and trigger a canary fallthrough to hosted pool.
Mia Rao: noted. I'm going to handoff in 15m to Ben. leaving checklist: burst-enabled, quotas-applied, prefetch-off, batch-size reduced, monitoring dashboards pinned.
Ben Cooper: taking handoff at 1789004921. i'll keep the incident channel monitored and coordinate with capacity team for next steps. please DM if anything changes before handoff. :+1:
incident-bot: Handoff recorded: oncall_from=Mia Rao oncall_to=Ben Cooper at=1789004921
Mia Rao: thanks all. leaving logs and commands in the incident doc. I'll follow up later with root cause once provider capacity details are in.
Carlos Nguyen: FYI i'll try the alternate instance types if provider reports capacity issues persist.
Jen Ortiz: will continue customer comms and escalate if any enterprise SLA risk.
Priya Shah: monitoring alerts: latency_p95, error_rate_5m, node_provisioning_time. set to critical thresholds for 30m.
incident-bot: INCIDENT NOTE: mitigation actions: burst capacity enabled; new-tenant quotas throttled; prefetch disabled; runtime batch size reduced. Next review in 20m.
Ben Cooper: acknowledged, standing by.
